findings.evidence: 'export the index with git checkout-index -a --prefix=<run>/verify/'. <run> is created inside the git dir, so the export path contains '/.git/'. Some runners, such as Jest's haste map, ignore files under VCS directories, so the check finds no tests and exits non-zero. The agent then reports a test failure that is not real.
findings.fix: Add a sentence after the export command: 'If the runner reports no tests found or no files matched in <run>/verify/, it is ignoring paths under .git: export to mktemp -d outside the repository instead (same link and cleanup rules), or report "staged version not verified"; never treat it as a test failure.'
